items.title: Lucknow to Host Third Regional Workshop on Training Institute Transformation on 23 and 24 October 2026
items.summary: Hon'ble Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Shri Yogi Adityanath, to inaugurate the workshop in the presence of Dr Jitendra Singh; eight States and four Union Territories of the Northern Region to participate 15 OCT 2026 10:56AM by PIB Delhi The Capacity Building Commission (CBC) will hold the third regional workshop of Sādhana Śhrinkhla 2026 at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, on 23 and 24 October 2026.

facts.text: It carries forward the conversation on institutional reform that the Commission has led over the past year through Regional Task Force meetings, Sādhana Saptah from 2 to 8 April 2026, and the National Departmental Summit on Institutionalising Capacity Building in May 2026.

Hosted by the Government of Uttar Pradesh, the workshop will see participation from the States of Bihar, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Punjab, Rajasthan and Uttarakhand, and the Union Territories of Chandigarh, Delhi, Jammu and Kashmir, and Ladakh.
Senior State officials will be joined by heads and faculty of Training Institutes, subject experts and industry partners.
